response.sql: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS average_share FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE v.points_won IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max IS NOT NULL AND v.points_max <> 0 GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, '')) SELECT country, average_share, average_share / (SELECT AVG(average_share) FROM country_averages) AS relative_ratio FROM country_averages ORDER BY country;
